alerts: Wild Turkey has partial shade and includes eight 10' tables, two portable tables, a 6' stone BBQ's, a fire circle with benches, and a drinking fountain with spigot. Flush toilets (ADA) and showers are located across the road.
SITE ACCESS: Wild Turkey is located in the family campground. All campground rules apply.

PARKING AND VEHICLES:15 Parking passes will be emailed 5-10 days before your reservation begins. Additional passes are not available for purchase. Buses, RVs, trailers, food trucks, or caterers are prohibited. Violators may be cited and/or towed.

ALCOHOL: Beer and wine allowed. No hard alcohol. Selling of alcoholic beverages, or consumption outside of your designated campsite is subject to citation. Anyone consuming alcohol is subject to state and local guidelines.
